newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PAL not actively looking for new investors.
newsitem.headline: PAL not actively looking for new investors.

text.p: Philippine Airlines (PAL) is not actively looking for new investors to take up the 12 percent unsubscribed portion of its increased capital stock, PAL president Jose Antonio Garcia said.
"Mr. (Lucio) Tan is not actively looking. But if there are interested investors, he will consider getting new investors," Garcia told reporters on Thursday night.

Tan, one of the country's wealthiest Chinese-Filipino tycoons, is the majority owner of the financially-beleaguered airline. The airline recently increased its capital to 15 billion pesos from 10 billion pesos to finance a programme to refleet.
Minority PAL stakeholders, which include five government institutions, decided to waive their right to subscribe, leaving 1.8 billion pesos ($64 million) worth of new shares unsubscribed.
Garcia said the airline has until the end of the month to finalise the subscription of the capital increase. Tan is expected to take up the unsubscribed shares if no deal is closed by then.
Garcia declined to identify who were the interested buyers but said they included local and foreign business groups.
Tan and other PAL top managers are currently in the United States to scout for new aircraft suppliers as part of its fleet upgrading programme.
"We are negotiating for new equipment, visiting new airlines," Garcia said.
PAL is currently undertaking a refleeting programme which it hopes will bring the airline into profitability.
PAL recently announced a worsening financial state, posting a net loss of 1.41 billion pesos in the fourth quarter to March 31, higher than the 1.2 billion loss in the third quarter.
"It's still rough sailing. We have a very difficult period to come...But I think this is a new beginning. We have a new fleet, new outlook, new enthusiasm," Garcia said.
As part of its restructuring plan, Garcia said the recently acquired subsidiary Macroasia Corp is likely to take on its non-airline activities.
